description: A majority of North Carolinians say the uncivil discourse that’s come to dominate political debate is hurting the country, according to a new poll.A survey of 800 registered voters earlier this month found that 86% agreed with the statement, “Political debate is a healthy process, but the current tone and tenor is only dividing the county and making matters worse.”A few results from the poll were released Tuesday at an event meant to demonstrate reasoned debate.Healthier United, a nonprofit, non

title: NC NEWSLINE: North Carolinians don’t like mean political debates, new poll says
